title: Final Electric Potential
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the scalar potential phi_omega in terms of the charge density rho_omega and the integral provided.

title: Final Magnetic Potential
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the vector potential A_omega in terms of the current density J_omega and the integral provided.

title: Charge-Current Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student must accurately state the continuity equation relating rho_omega and J_omega in Fourier space.

title: Far Zone Fields
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the expressions for the electric field E_omega and magnetic field B_omega in the far zone.

title: Current Density Expression
description: Optional Criteria: The student should correctly identify and express the current density J_omega as r f(r) for the given problem.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the expressions for the potentials or fields derived.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivations and final expressions.
